**The Integration Layer: ACE and Informatica ETL**
ACE and Informatica ETL are complementary capabilities within the Commercial Lines Integration Layer. ACE supports real-time application, messaging, API, and service integration, while Informatica ETL extracts, transforms, and loads data across operational systems, analytical processes, files, vendors, and downstream consumers.
